name: PGPIC
note: Esteghlal FC's current main shirt sponsor and majority shareholder. TSE-listed holding (symbol فارس); Iran's largest petrochemical group, sanctioned by the US Treasury in June 2019. Rating note: the pull request for this research proposes Serious. The link: the Oil Industry Pension Fund group — self-described as a Petroleum Ministry subsidiary (ANA, 2024-08-14) — is PGPIC's largest shareholder with 38% (Asr-e Iran, 2026-09-05; EcoIran gave 30% for its affiliates in March 2024) and took three of the five board seats at the September 2026 AGM (Petrochemiha and EnergyPress, 2026-09-16). 38% plus a board majority reads as control; maintainers may prefer Concern if they read it as short of control. The record: iran-ffmi-crimes-against-humanity-record and iran-executions-2025-record. It sits under the Petroleum Ministry (chairman's statement, ANA 2024-08-14; the minister chairs the fund's trustees and appoints its board — Asr-e Naft 2026-07-18 and EnergyPress 2024-09-09).
